narrative.overview:
Veasna looks like a tidy board of queue cards at a pop-up village clinic. White cards sit on a cool, near-white canvas. Each station keeps its own colour and icon wherever it appears. Patient markers (the red TB flag, the family letter, the coloured sticker) stand out from across a tent, and everything else stays quiet. The mood is calm, clear and friendly: soft rounded surfaces and gentle motion, never cold and clinical, and never playful enough to pull a volunteer's attention from the patient in front of them.

The UI is dense where staff scan (queues, tables, forms in small text) and generous around them (cards with 20–24px padding, a 1600px maximum width). Brand lives in one place: Project Battambang blue marks what is active and what to press. The other colours all carry meaning, not decoration: station identity, family grouping, sticker matching, warnings and danger.

The interface is designed for light mode only. A few badges carry `dark:` variants, but the theme tokens have no dark set, so don't treat dark mode as supported.
keyCharacteristics: One brand accent (Project Battambang blue). All other colour is meaning: stations, families, stickers, status.
White cards on a mist canvas, softly lifted with a small shadow.
Pills for status and selection, gently rounded rectangles for actions and fields.
Frosted-glass pills for secondary round actions and the segmented control's sliding highlight.
Small, tactile motion: a 1px lift on hover, a press-in on click, fades on entry, all off under reduced motion.
One typeface, TeX Gyre Heros, bundled with the app so it works offline.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Project Battambang blue is the only colour that means "active" or "press here". Never use a station, family or status colour for an action.

rules.name: The Red Means TB or Danger Rule
rules.body: Red is reserved for suspected TB and destructive or invalid states. Never use it for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Station Colour Is Fixed Rule
rules.body: A station's tone and icon are the same everywhere it appears (`components/shared/StationBadge.tsx`). Never recolour a station locally.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Everything is TeX Gyre Heros. Don't add a display or mono family, and don't load fonts from the internet.

rules.name: The Lift Means Clickable Rule
rules.body: Only things you can press lift on hover. Static cards keep their resting shadow.

dos: **Do** use Project Battambang blue (`--primary`) for every active, selected or primary state, and `--ring` for focus.
**Do** show a patient's TB, family and sticker markers wherever the patient appears.
**Do** reuse `StationBadge`, `TbBadge`, `FamilyBadge` and `StickerTag` instead of restyling them.
**Do** keep text at 14px (body) and 12px (labels), and give queue numbers tabular figures.
**Do** pair every animation with a `motion-reduce` fallback, as `src/lib/motion.ts` does.
**Do** confirm every destructive action in a dialog that says what will happen.
**Do** turn the final Submit red (with the shield icon) when the patient is flagged for suspected TB.
**Do** show failures inline, next to the action, saying what was kept and what to do next. Never use browser `alert()` pop-ups.
donts: **Don't** use a station, family or status colour for an action or for decoration.
**Don't** use red for anything other than suspected TB, destructive actions and invalid fields.
**Don't** use hard-coded Tailwind `blue-*` classes for focus or primary states. Some forms (`components/patient-form/`) and Analytics still do; move them to `primary` and `ring` when touched.
**Don't** load fonts, icons or images from the internet. Everything is served by the host.
